mapper.select: SELECT pq.id, pq.paper_id AS paperId, pq.question_id AS questionId, pq.score, q.title, q.A AS optionA, q.B AS optionB, q.C AS optionC, q.D AS optionD, q.answer FROM paper_question pq LEFT JOIN question q ON pq.question_id = q.id WHERE pq.paper_id = #{paperId}
SELECT q.id AS question_id, q.answer, pq.score FROM paper_question pq LEFT JOIN question q ON pq.question_id = q.id WHERE pq.paper_id = #{paperId}

SELECT pq.question_id AS questionId, q.title, q.a AS optionA, q.b AS optionB, q.c AS optionC, q.d AS optionD, pq.score FROM paper_question pq LEFT JOIN question q ON pq.question_id = q.id WHERE pq.paper_id = #{paperId} ORDER BY pq.id ASC
